title: CBO algorithm with average drift and applications to portfolio optimization
summary: We propose a consensus based optimization algorithm with average drift (in short Ad-CBO) and provide a theoretical framework for it. In the theoretical analysis, we show that particle solutions to Ad-CBO converge to a global minimizer. In numerical simulations, we examine Ad-CBO's performance in optimizing static and dynamic objective functions. As a real-time application, we test the efficiency of Ad-CBO to find the optimal portfolio given stochastically evolving multi-asset prices in a financial market.
